parts.title: January 2026
parts.html:
Padma Awards 2026

  • The President approved 131 Padma Awards: 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri; 19 women and 16 posthumous.
  • Padma Vibhushan: actor Dharmendra (posthumous), violinist N. Rajam, K.T. Thomas, P. Narayanan and V.S. Achuthanandan (posthumous).
  • Padma Bhushan includes Alka Yagnik, Mammootty, Uday Kotak, Vijay Amritraj, Bhagat Singh Koshyari, Shibu Soren (posthumous) and ad-man Piyush Pandey (posthumous).
  • Padma Shri for sport: Rohit Sharma, Harmanpreet Kaur, Savita Punia and para high-jumper Praveen Kumar.
Padma Awards: instituted in 1954 (same year as the Bharat Ratna); renamed into three classes in 1955; announced on the eve of Republic Day; not given in 1978, 1979 and 1993–97.

Bravery and service honours

  • Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla received the Ashoka Chakra, the top peacetime gallantry award, for the Axiom-4 mission to the ISS.
  • Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar 2026: Lt Col Sita Ashok Shelke (individual, Wayanad 2024 relief) and Sikkim State Disaster Management Authority (institution).
  • Jeevan Raksha Padak 2025 to 30 people: 6 Sarvottam, 6 Uttam and 18 Jeevan Raksha.
  • 982 police, fire, home guard and correctional personnel got medals on Republic Day, including 125 gallantry medals.
  • The 70th Ati Vishisht Rail Seva Puraskar went to 100 railway officials.

Awards to institutions

  • C-DOT won the SKOCH Award 2025 for its Cell Broadcast Solution, which pushes disaster alerts to phones in real time.
  • Ministry of Steel will give the first Bharat Steel Awards 2026 in 7 categories.
  • Model Youth Gram Sabha: JNV Una (Himachal) and EMRS Kosambuda (Chhattisgarh) won Rs 1 crore each.
  • MoSPI invited entries for the biennial Sukhatme Rashtriya Puraskar (since 2000, statisticians over 45), to be given on Statistics Day, 29 June.
  • SAIL got 'Great Place to Work' certification for the third time in a row; BSE won the Asia Best Employer Brand Award.
  • Symbiosis School of Culinary Arts, Pune won the first PHDCCI National Young Chef Competition.

World honours

  • Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development 2025: Graça Machel of Mozambique (Rs 1 crore).
  • Tyler Prize 2026 ('Nobel of the environment'): US biologist Toby Kiers for work on underground fungal networks.
  • UN Secretariat Award (gender category): Major Swati Shanta Kumar, for the 'Equal Partners, Lasting Peace' project in South Sudan.
  • 83rd Golden Globes: 'Hamnet' (drama film) and 'One Battle After Another' (musical/comedy); Paul Thomas Anderson best director; 'KPop Demon Hunters' best animated film; 'The Secret Agent' (Brazil) best non-English film; 'Adolescence' swept limited series.
